name: TidBITS Talk: Black Friday deals thread
accepts: Tech and accessories TidBITS might cover. A yearly 'TidBITS-appropriate Black Friday deals' thread is opened by the editor (2026: https://talk.tidbits.com/t/tidbits-appropriate-black-friday-2026-deals/34592).
how_to_submit: Post in the thread from a TidBITS Talk (Discourse) account.
rules: The FAQ only bars spam. Nothing covers self-promotion or AI-written posts.
Developers have posted their own apps there with a disclosure line first ('I'm the developer, so this is self-interested.'), one line on the app and the plain price, without objection.
Discourse usually limits links in a brand-new account's first posts; TidBITS does not publish its limits.
The 2026 thread had 9 posts and 468 views on 19 Nov 2026.
